scheme_name: Education Assistance for the Construction Workers
other_conditions: Applicant must have served the Board for at least 90 days in a given year.
Applicant must be a child of a registered construction worker.
Applicant must be studying in one of the specified classes (Class 1‑8, 9‑10, 11‑12, Graduation, ITI, L.L.B., Polytechnic Diploma, Technical courses, or distance/open learning).
Scholarships are provided up to two nominated children of a registered and living member of the Board.
benefits_summary: Provides monthly scholarships ranging from ₹500 to ₹10,000 depending on the class or level of study of the child.
